title: PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research
verification_method: arXiv record cross-checked with the OpenAI project page
support_scope: PaperBench evaluates end-to-end replication of 20 ICML 2024 Spotlight and Oral papers.
The published evaluated agent score cited in this project is 21.0%, when explicitly attributed to PaperBench.
limitations_for_use: Its replication score must not be compared numerically with EviGateBench pilot outcomes.
